change.summary: Use existing Paxi loader to enable the existing Create Immersive Aircrafts Resource Pack automatically after native managed download.

modifiers.before: ZIP exists in ordinary resourcepacks directory; downloading it does not force selection.
modifiers.after: Same ZIP under config/paxi/resourcepacks with explicit resourcepack_load_order entry; existing Paxi owns discovery/enabling on client startup. Remove obsolete ordinary resourcepacks copy; no new loader or options.txt edit.

rationale.decision_source: User requested this behavior, initially preparation only; subsequent user authorization requests actual local Server and Client application. Implementation seams chosen by Codex.
